description: Invite a person to a Proton Drive file or folder by email. Immediately sends an email notification — confirm the address and role with the user first. Roles: 'viewer' (read-only), 'editor' (read + write), 'admin' (read + write + reshare). Run drive_share_status first: a duplicate invitation may silently overwrite the existing role. The server asks the user to approve this itself.

confirmed.description: Optional and ignored: the server asks the user to approve this itself. You do not need to send it.

email.description: Email address of the person to invite.

message.description: Optional message included in the invitation email (max 500 characters — Proton rejects longer ones).

path.description: Absolute remote Drive path to share (must start with '/').

role.description: 'viewer' = read-only, 'editor' = read + write, 'admin' = read + write + reshare.

name: drive_share_invite
title: Invite to share
